description: Diagnostic module to investigate why permission_scope, temporal_stability, and tool_description_safety still show only 4 distinct values after recent enrichment builds. Query mcp_signal_scores and mcp_signal_enrichments directly to identify the actual score distribution per signal. Recent enrichments were built (permission_scope_enrichment.py at 09:26:09, temporal_stability_enrichment.py at 09:24:16, tool_description_safety_enrichment_v2.py at 10:56:48) but may not be writing to the database or may have compute_score functions that return near-constant values. Report cardinality per signal_type, sample evidence blobs, and confirm whether the enrichments are being invoked by signal_analyser.
